title: The 98.6 Body Temperature Standard Failed Two Tests
hook: The famous normal temperature misses both modern bodies and old measurements.
closing: Normal is a range, because bodies changed and the original standard was never exact.
question: What's your resting temperature?

segments.say: Modern men average 97.5 degrees. Today's bodies already fall below the famous standard.
Men's temperature fell 1.06 degrees. The gap reflects a real generational shift, not random readings.
Old thermometer records recalculate to 98.2 degrees. The original standard was high before modern cooling began.
